name: Network Adapter Manager
description:
Manage network adapters and perform common network troubleshooting and reset operations.
- List all network adapters.
- Enable selected network adapter.
- Disable selected network adapter.
- Release and renew IP address (DHCP).
- Flush DNS cache.
- Reset TCP/IP stack.
- Reset Winsock catalog.
- Perform full network reset (all actions combined, reboot recommended).
